description: Projects + Services + Experience + Contact + Footer sections, plus the final assembly in app/page.js and updated app/layout.js metadata. These are the remaining five visible sections. Independent of FEAT-002's implementation details but depends on FEAT-001's design system. After this FEAT the site is complete and buildable.
steps: Create components/Projects.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText, GradientButton from ui; import { PROJECTS } from '@/lib/data'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { Github, ExternalLink, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react'. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='projects'. Section header: label + AnimatedText headline 'Featured Projects' + subtitle text. Projects layout: vertical stack of large featured project cards, one per project. Each card: bg-bg-card rounded-2xl border border-border overflow-hidden grid lg:grid-cols-2 gap-0. Left half: project screenshot placeholder — a div with the project's gradient (from data.gradient) applied as background, aspect-ratio 16/9 or fixed height 280px, containing: project number in large faded text (01, 02), a mock browser chrome frame (3 small colored dots + address bar) rendered as divs, inside the 'browser' a simplified representation of the project (colored blocks, text lines as divs of varying widths, using the project's gradient as accent). On hover the screenshot div scales to 1.02 with overflow hidden on parent. Right half: project details — tech category pill, project title in text-2xl font-display font-bold, description paragraph, tech stack chips (each chip: bg-bg-secondary text-text-secondary text-xs px-3 py-1 rounded-full border border-border), two buttons: GradientButton outline size='sm' with Github icon + 'Code', GradientButton primary size='sm' with ExternalLink icon + 'Live Demo'. Alternate layout: even-indexed cards have screenshot left, odd-indexed swap (lg:order-2 for screenshot on odd). Card entrance: slide in from left/right alternating using initial={{ x: index % 2 === 0 ? -60 : 60, opacity: 0 }}.

Create components/Services.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText from ui; import { SERVICES } from '@/lib/data'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { Code2, Layers, Zap, TrendingUp, Smartphone, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react'. Create an ICON_MAP: { Code2, Layers, Zap, TrendingUp, Smartphone, MessageSquare }. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='services'. Section header: label + AnimatedText headline 'What I Do'. Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Each service card: bg-bg-card rounded-2xl p-6 border border-border relative overflow-hidden. Top: icon in a gradient-filled rounded-xl 48x48 container (bg-gradient-to-br from-accent/20 to-accent-secondary/20 with the lucide icon at 24px in accent color). Title: text-xl font-semibold text-text-primary mt-4 mb-2. Description: text-text-secondary text-sm. Hover effect: the card gets border-accent/50, and a radial gradient glow appears from the card top-left corner using a ::before-like overlay div (absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-accent/5 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100). Use motion.div with whileHover={{ y: -6 }} transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300 }}. Staggered entrance: each card initial={{ opacity:0, y:30 }} animate when parent inView.

Create components/Experience.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText from ui; import { EXPERIENCE } from '@/lib/data'; import { motion, useInView } from 'framer-motion'; import { GraduationCap, Briefcase, Calendar } from 'lucide-react'. Create ICON_MAP: { GraduationCap, Briefcase }. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='experience'. Section header: label + AnimatedText headline 'Journey'. Two-column layout: left column 'Experience', right column 'Education' — split EXPERIENCE array by type. Each column renders a vertical timeline: a vertical line down the center-left of the column (2px, gradient from accent to transparent). Each timeline item: flex row with left dot + card. Dot: w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-accent border-2 border-bg-primary, positioned on the vertical line. Card: ml-8 bg-bg-card rounded-xl p-5 border border-border mb-6. Card content: icon in small accent-bg pill top-right, org name in text-accent text-sm font-medium, title in text-text-primary font-semibold text-base, date with Calendar icon in text-text-muted text-xs, description in text-text-secondary text-sm mt-2. Animation: each card slides in from left with useInView, staggered 0.15s.

Create components/Contact.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import SectionWrapper, AnimatedText, GradientButton from ui; import { PERSONAL } from '@/lib/data'; import { useState } from 'react'; import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { Mail, MapPin, Send, Github, Linkedin, Twitter } from 'lucide-react'. Wrap in SectionWrapper id='contact'. Two-column layout (lg:grid-cols-5): left col (lg:col-span-2) has contact info card, right col (lg:col-span-3) has the form. Left card: bg-bg-card rounded-2xl p-8 border border-border. Heading 'Get In Touch', subtext encouraging contact. Contact detail rows: Mail icon + email, MapPin icon + location. Social links: three icon buttons (Github, Linkedin, Twitter) that open links in new tab. Right: contact form — name, email, subject, message (textarea rows=5). Each field: label above, input/textarea with bg-bg-secondary border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-text-primary placeholder-text-muted focus:border-accent focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent transition-colors. Submit button: GradientButton primary full-width with Send icon. Form state: formData object with useState, handleChange updates fields, handleSubmit prevents default and shows a success state (replace form with a thank-you message using AnimatePresence). Add proper aria-labels to all inputs for accessibility.

Create components/Footer.jsx. Mark 'use client'. Import { motion } from 'framer-motion'; import { Github, Linkedin, Twitter, Heart, ArrowUp } from 'lucide-react'; import { PERSONAL } from '@/lib/data'. Full-width section with bg-bg-secondary border-t border-border. Inner max-w-7xl mx-auto px-6 py-12. Three rows: top row: logo left (same gradient text as navbar) + nav links center + social icons right. Middle row: thin divider. Bottom row: copyright left ('© 2024 Chukwuebuka. Built with Next.js & Tailwind CSS'), 'Made with Heart icon' center, 'Back to top' button right (ArrowUp icon, scrolls to top on click). Back-to-top: motion.button whileHover={{ y: -3 }}, onClick calls window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }). Social icons: motion.a whileHover={{ scale: 1.2, color: accent }}. Heart icon: text-accent animate with a subtle pulse.

Replace app/page.js. Keep it a Server Component (no 'use client'). Import all 9 components: Navbar, Hero, About, Skills, Projects, Services, Experience, Contact, Footer. Return a main element wrapping them in order. No additional wrapper divs needed — each component handles its own section styling. This file has NO state or effects so stays a Server Component.

Verify app/layout.js has the correct font setup from FEAT-001 step 2. If not yet done (it was listed in FEAT-001), ensure: imports Inter and Sora from next/font/google, applies --font-sans and --font-display CSS variable classNames to html element, metadata includes title and description. Do not add 'use client'.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 with all 9 sections rendered
Projects cards render with mock screenshot placeholders and correct tech chips
Services grid shows 6 service cards with lucide icons
Experience timeline renders education and experience items in two columns
Contact form has accessible labels, handles input state, shows success on submit
Footer has back-to-top button and social links
app/page.js imports all 9 components and is a Server Component
verification: npm run build — must complete with exit 0 and no errors
